title: limonium roseum
intro: Limonium roseum, commonly known as RoseMARY or Sea Lavender, is a flowering plant in the Plumbaginaceae family. It is known for its calming and relaxing properties, and has been used to reduce stress and promote better sleep. The health benefits of Limonium roseum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and skin irritations.
